rubric.role_summary: Enterprise expansion account manager responsible for growth and retention across a portfolio of large customers, working with customer success on renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Enterprise expansion account manager responsible for growth and retention across a portfolio of large customers, working with customer success on renewals, upsells, and cross-sells.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years managing and selling into mid-market SaaS accounts.
- Proficiency with CRM and reporting tools.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- 3+ years managing and selling into mid-market SaaS accounts ($5M+ in GMV), with a proven track record of driving growth through expansion across portfolios exceeding $1M ARR.
- Experience engaging and influencing C-level executives.
- Experience reviewing and interpreting data trends to identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and present solutions to clients.
- Ability to diagnose customer pain points and develop tailored solutions.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Toronto area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
